notes: All 164 pieces are listed and each type and colour matches the parts list count.

The build is intentionally three separate groups, and I kept it that way. The theater is b1-b139. The Black car is b140-b151 (pages 22-23). The Blue truck is b152-b164 (pages 24-25). The booklet builds the two vehicles as standalone models and never attaches them to the theater or to each other. Page 26 shows all three side by side with no connection, so adding a join between them would invent a connection that does not exist.
The booklet pictures are small, so many rests_on lists are my best reading of the layout. Treat them as approximate. The piece types, colours and counts are exact.

The dark tan masonry bricks b102-b104 (step 21) rest on the 2x4 plates b92-b94, not on the White grille tiles b97-b99, which have no studs. The grille tiles are decorative back-edge pieces (step 20) and nothing rests on them.
Step 2 is the Dark Blue 2x4 tile (lego-87079). The Dark Blue 2x2 tile (lego-3068b) is used in step 25.
The wheel clip plates (lego-4081b) are assumed to hold two wheels each, one on each side. Each wheel stud is joined to a clip.

Step 24's two 1x1 White plates are stacked on the lower White 1x1 brick with side stud (b109). The upper 87087 and curved brick (b126, b127) go on top. The 1x4 yellow-light plate (b129) clips onto the side studs of both 87087 bricks, which are 2 studs apart.
The Black tap (4599b) joins the headlight brick's side stud sideways. The Trans-Clear round plate on top is recorded as resting on the tap.

The lamp post sub-assembly (step 30) is a Trans-Clear round plate and then a Black round plate on the post, with a clip plate and White tile on the post's side. The post sits on Green plate b20. The Green cone sits on the Reddish Brown round plate b33.
